# Results One LLC

> Results One LLC is a Washington, DC-based consulting firm specializing in
> digital accessibility, disability inclusion, workforce and leadership
> development, and AI strategy for nonprofits and public-sector organizations.
> The firm helps organizations meet ADA, Section 508, and WCAG 2.1 Level AA
> requirements and build more inclusive, higher-performing workplaces.

Contact: info@ResultsOneLLC.com | https://www.resultsonellc.com/
Service area: United States

## Services

- [Our Services](https://www.resultsonellc.com/services): Index of every service area.
- [ADA Training & Consultation](https://www.resultsonellc.com/ada-training-and-consultation): Interactive ADA training and consultation from two certified ADA trainers: fundamentals, accommodations, accessible customer service, communication, and digital accessibility.
- [Digital Accessibility Services](https://www.resultsonellc.com/digital-accessibility-testing-training): Parent service covering nine digital accessibility offerings, from audits through video accessibility.
  - [Accessibility Audits & Assessments](https://www.resultsonellc.com/accessibility-audits-and-assessments): Automated, manual and assistive technology testing of websites, mobile apps and digital documents against WCAG, Section 508 and applicable ADA requirements, with a prioritized remediation report.
  - [Remediation Support](https://www.resultsonellc.com/remediation-support): Hands-on support for correcting the barriers testing finds, across websites, digital content and electronic documents including PDFs, Word files, PowerPoint decks and forms.
  - [Accessibility Training & Workshops](https://www.resultsonellc.com/accessibility-training-and-workshops): Customized sessions for executives, developers, content creators, communications and procurement teams, delivered as workshops, Lunch & Learns, virtual training or leadership briefings.
  - [Ongoing Compliance Monitoring](https://www.resultsonellc.com/ongoing-compliance-monitoring): Monthly, quarterly or risk-based monitoring: automated scans, targeted manual testing, regression testing and periodic reporting so new barriers are caught early.
  - [VPAT/ACR Development](https://www.resultsonellc.com/vpat-acr-development): Evaluation of digital products and preparation of an Accessibility Conformance Report that gives procurement professionals meaningful information, not marketing copy.
  - [Policy & Strategy Consulting](https://www.resultsonellc.com/policy-and-strategy-consulting): Policies, governance, roadmaps, procurement requirements and accessibility statements that turn individual projects into an organization-wide accessibility program.
  - [Community & User Testing](https://www.resultsonellc.com/community-and-user-testing): Task-based testing with people who use assistive technology, revealing usability barriers that automated tools and technical conformance checks alone do not capture.
  - [AI & Accessibility](https://www.resultsonellc.com/ai-and-accessibility): Training and consultation on where AI removes barriers for people with disabilities — and on accuracy, bias, privacy and the risk of assuming automation is accessible.
  - [Video & Multimedia Accessibility](https://www.resultsonellc.com/video-and-multimedia-accessibility): Audio description, closed captioning, caption and description remediation, accessible transcripts, and phased remediation plans for large video libraries.
- [Disability Inclusion Services](https://www.resultsonellc.com/disability-and-inclusion): Disability inclusion strategy, policy, and culture work.
- [Leadership for Organizational Success](https://www.resultsonellc.com/leadership-for-organizational-success): Parent service covering INSIGHT, leadership development, change management, executive coaching, and strategic planning.
- [Leadership Development Training](https://www.resultsonellc.com/leadership-development-training): Courses for current and emerging leaders.
- [INSIGHT](https://www.resultsonellc.com/insight): Results One's leadership insight offering.
- [Executive Coaching](https://www.resultsonellc.com/executive-coaching): One-on-one coaching for executives and senior leaders.
- [Professional Development Training](https://www.resultsonellc.com/training): Customized, cost-effective training programs.
- [Workforce Development Training](https://www.resultsonellc.com/human-capital-services): Workforce capacity building.
- [Employee Resource Training](https://www.resultsonellc.com/employee-resource-training): Training for employee resource groups.
- [Strategic Planning](https://www.resultsonellc.com/strategic-planning): Facilitated organizational strategy work.
- [Change Management](https://www.resultsonellc.com/change-management): Support for organizational transitions.
- [AI Strategy and Enablement for Nonprofits](https://www.resultsonellc.com/ai-strategy-nonprofits): Practical AI strategy, workflows, policy, and training for mission-driven organizations.
